description: Lucee Form Extension 2.0 provides essential form tags (cfform, cfinput, cfselect, etc.) specifically designed for Jakarta EE environments like Tomcat 10+. This version is fully compatible with Jakarta Servlet specifications and requires Lucee 7. For Lucee 6 installations, please use Form Extension 1.0 instead. The extension delivers the same familiar functionality while ensuring seamless operation in modern servlet containers that have migrated to the jakarta namespace.
